But don't let your guard down: Golcats are Gods, and acting like they're weak to lure in unsuspecting adventurers and steal their wallets is what they're all about. Get too close, and they'll grab your Gren and run off with a triumphant look on their face. Golcat attacks have been increasing in recent years

name: Golcat King
description: A Golcat with a little money saved up starts wearing a crown like they own the place, but it's still the same Glan-obsessed Golcat inside. Adventurers who see this puffed-up fat cat tend to assume their wallets are safe... just before having their wallet stolen by them. And good luck catching up to them! They're faster than your average Golcat. There are rumors of a Golcat hideaway, but the details are sketchy.

name: Golcat God
description: A very, very, rich Golcat. But what can change the nature of a Golcat? Not money, that's for sure. It may wear a lot of fancy jewelry, but it does not live a fancy lifestyle. The Golcat's hoarding was long seen as an inborn biological trait, but recent research indicates that they may be accumulating money for some kind of purpose, though what that purpose might be remains unclear.

name: Metal Egg
description: A rare, metallic lifeform that accumulates large amounts of knowledge within its shell. A hero soul that merges with it gains its knowledge as experience, making them sought-after targets for adventurers. However, there is much that is not known about its ecology and behavior, making their capture extremely difficult. Because of this, areas where Metal Eggs are spotted frequently become adventurer shanty towns overnight.

name: Metal Chicken
description: A Metal Egg that accumulates even more knowledge grows into a Metal Chicken. Hero souls that merge with them gain an incalculable amount of experience. They're far faster than Eggs, meaning that even if you manage to spot one, actually capturing it is another question entirely. After the struggle of capturing a Metal Chicken, many adventurers find themselves emotionally attached and unable to let them go.

description: A knight aspiring to become the perfect soldier. Small yet resilient, she uses a style of spear work developed since living with her family. She does feel shame about her underdeveloped artistic skill, but that, along with everything else, is forgotten when she starts training. Not even she realizes how deeply she becomes absorbed, since most of her sessions are solo. As expected of a cultural metropolis, those who share her interests in combat are few and far between.
comment_gain:
To protect the people of my country,
I'll do whatever I must, even if that means
painting, acting or singing!
comment_powerup:
Drilling isn't painful.
The moment your efforts bear fruit
is the greatest of all!
comment_evolution:
I'm not much for the arts,
but I will continue to devote myself
to as a protector of passion!
comment_limitberak:
I care nothing for limits!
I'll surpass them as often as I must!
comment_fortune_max:
I never expected to receive this much support...
Thank you very much! I'm overjoyed!

name: Passionate Thespian Sharon
description: A member of the Stella Squad. Famous for her performances in comedies, operas, and musicals, she has fans of all kinds. Beneath her charm and poise is a shrewd mind that will not hesitate to speak out. As the oldest member of the squad, she will help the others but always with a cutting remark or two. Her favorite phrase is "cash-in-hand payment", born from her love of money.
comment_gain:
I'm Sharon, the sensible one of
the Stella Squad. Ask me for help whenever,
but keep in mind I charge overtime.
comment_powerup:
I appreciate the help, dear.
Here's 3 Gren for a tip.
Don't spend it all in one place.
comment_limitberak:
Ah, I've finally immersed myself in this role.
Even I can learn a thing or two sometimes!
comment_fortune_max:
Luck is finally headed my way!

so I won't waste this opportunity!

name: Brilliant Actress Sharon
description: A popular actress who works as event hostess for the Stella Squad. The wealth of connections provided by her acting career makes her the most informed of the group. As such, she is usually first to know when some scheme is afoot, and she is no stranger to the early-morning bar scene as a result. Much of her income goes towards her troupe, leaving little if anything to line her purse.
comment_gain:
That should do it for the rehearsal.
Time to give the performance of a lifetime!
comment_powerup:
This is a good stopping point. Take five!
Oh, you want some of my water?
It's 100 Gren per cup.
comment_evolution:
Nothing will stop me from becoming
Minchenne's greatest actress!
comment_limitberak:
Ah, I've finally immersed myself in this role.
Even I can learn a thing or two sometimes!
comment_fortune_max:
Luck is finally headed my way!
I know how fickle it can be,
so I won't waste this opportunity!

name: Passionate Offbeat Rits
description: Musician and knight of the Stella Squad. From her unique way of talking, she is assumed to be in her late teens. She was born into a musical family, giving her superb talent with stringed instruments. Her eccentrics can be shocking at times and might leave the impression she is imprudent, but she always looks after her squadmates.
comment_gain:
Welcome, newbie!
Rits is my name, music is my game!
Nice to make your acquaintance!
comment_powerup:
Chi! Chi!
Cascading like a river!
comment_limitberak:
No performance is perfect!
Improvement is always possible!
comment_fortune_max:
Yay!
Life is beautiful!

name: Solace Virtuosa Rits
description: The heiress of Muraku Itto-Ryu, a style of musical swordplay with over 400 years of history. She firmly believes in her duty to protect the passion of artists. As a performer herself, her behavior also tends to stand out. This is especially true on days off when she wanders to and fro, guided only by whimsy. Though she seems unpredictable, her new partner Salyssa says there is indeed a definite logic behind her curiosity.
comment_gain:
I protect the innocent!
That is the purpose of my sword!
comment_powerup:
I can't control my fingers!
Listen to their song of gratitude!
comment_evolution:
How emotional!
I never thought I could make this tone!
comment_limitberak:
No performance is perfect!
Improvement is always possible!
comment_fortune_max:
Yay!
Life is beautiful!

name: Passionate Painter Raine
description: A knight of the Stella Squad, though she claims her main occupation is court painter. She is a prodigy who has worked on many masterpieces, earning her scores of fans both at home and abroad. Beneath her quiet, cool demeanor is a shy loner, so she treats her squad mates as close family, including how she tends to over-rely on them. Her role in the group is drawing for the royal newsletter and other official circulations.
comment_gain:
You called me, so don't leave me behind.
I dislike being alone...
comment_powerup: A painting reflects the artist.
comment_limitberak:
Artist's block is all in the mind.
The more you focus on it, the larger it grows.
comment_fortune_max:
Thanks for all your effort.
Let's keep going.

name: Raine, Font of Imagination
description: A court painter affiliated with the Stella Squad. Her main purview is fine art, so she illustrates for government publications and plans museum exhibits. She can also perform on stage if the need arises, but she prefers a supportive role away from the spotlight. Even so, she will take action whenever she sees anyone in trouble like a true Defender of Passion.
comment_gain: Hold still, I'm painting your portrait.
comment_powerup: I draw my own path.
comment_evolution:
It's too bad there are only
24 hours in a day to draw...
comment_limitberak:
Artist's block is all in the mind.
The more you focus on it, the larger it grows.
comment_fortune_max:
Thanks for all your effort.
Let's keep going.

name: Spirit of Freedom Alulu
description: An orphan who was raised by a professor at a magic academy in Minchenne, the capital of Bamint. From a young age, she demonstrated great talent in magic, especially when it came to controlling inorganic matter. She loved her foster parent and the magic he taught her and was the quiet type who'd continuously work on her magic skill. But ironically, the country's pronounced focus on the fine arts made her feel like an outcast.
comment_gain:
Deep down, do you know the feeling...?
For what you love to not be accepted?
comment_powerup:
Stay true to the fundamentals.
That is what Father taught me.
comment_limitberak:
Higher...! I'll reach even greater heights!
There are no limits to Father's magic!
comment_fortune_max:
I have no way to repay you...
But you fill with me joy! Thank you.

name: Child of Creation Alulu
description: A genius magician living in Bamint. She is usually reticent but will talk at length about her favorite subjects, like sorcery. Her helpful nature has made her popular at the magic school, particularly among the younger students, and praise will bring a small, shy smile to her face. Although she finds her country's obsession with fine arts irritating, she does not look down on the interests of others.
comment_gain:
This country's obsession stole my father!
The arts can burn for all I care!
comment_powerup:
I swear I'll become stronger.

comment_evolution:
I'll make them all cower in amazement...
With just how maginificent Father's magic is!
comment_limitberak:
Higher...! I'll reach even greater heights!
There are no limits to Father's magic!
comment_fortune_max:
I have no way to repay you...
But you fill with me joy! Thank you.

name: Marika
description: A young but brilliant mechanical engineer. Her old workshop in the capital grew too cramped and cluttered, convincing her to move to Reigrad where rent was more affordable. However, she tends to keep her distance from strangers, so she has made few friends besides Rayas and Iris. Combat is not her strongest suit, but she can overcome any situation with her calm judgment and self-made inventions.
comment_gain:
*yawn* Ugh, my back is killing me
since I slept in the garage again. This bites...
Huh? Who are you?
comment_powerup: I like learning new things.
comment_limitberak: Creative destruction, huh? I like it.
comment_fortune_max:
What a surprise. A phenomenon
like this can't be called a fluke.

name: Awoken Marika
description: A girl who recently befriended Rayas and Iris. Mechanically inclined from a young age, she quickly became one of Isliid's brightest engineers. However, the unilateral praise for her talent and originality has yet to reach her ears since she is indifferent to the industry at large. Rather, she values her parents' lessons and works tirelessly (with the help of banana shakes) to create ever more innovations.
comment_gain:
I don't care if you're the Emperor himself.
Wake me up again and you'll regret it.
comment_powerup:
You can't just read manuals all day.
It's important to get your hands dirty, too.
comment_evolution:
Would you believe it if I told you
that was like the Singularity?
comment_limitberak: Creative destruction, huh? I like it.
comment_fortune_max:
What a surprise. A phenomenon
like this can't be called a fluke.

name: Noel
description: A young knight serving in the emperor's personal force, the Zero Guard. He carries out his orders with refined swordsmanship and a number of other techniques, and his earnest predisposition guarantees he puts in the maximum effort towards into all of his missions. He is chivalrous to all but his enemies, who may unfortunate enough to see his ruthless side. His love of sweets, especially doughnuts, is also well-known.
comment_gain:
I'm so glad I finally found you.
Now that I'm by your side,
we'll never be apart.
comment_powerup:
Whenever I'm with you,
I feel like I can take on the world.
comment_limitberak: Huh, that wasn't so hard.
comment_fortune_max:
Fate can be changed.
I thought that was obvious.

name: Awoken Noel
description: A knight serving the emperor of Isliid, born to a high-ranking officer and a librarian. This granted him an advantage in both military and literary arts, not only allowing hime to skip grades at the military academy but also graduate as valedictorian. He took full advantage of his status as a prodigy, but jealousy and lack of understanding kept him from making friends. His life of loneliness continued until he met a special someone who turned his life around. He now seriously attends to his duties, putting forth his full effort.
comment_gain:
So we meet again.
This time you won't get away.

With this power, I'll protect

comment_limitberak: Huh, that wasn't so hard.
comment_fortune_max:
Fate can be changed.

name: Batiste
description: A member of the Emperor's Zero Guard, a cool realist with a dry wit. His objective, logical, and constructive decisions have made him a good superior and partner to Noel. In combat, he uses countless knives and agility to perplex foes before striking from their blind spot. His one shortcoming is that his focus on efficiency can come off as inconsideration by those unaware of his goal to help as many as possible. He claims to have no hobbies but diligently keeps a journal.
comment_gain:
I'm Batiste of the Zero Guard.
I vow to protect you to the best
of my ability, come what may.
comment_powerup: Daily training is another one of my duties
comment_limitberak:
Each obstacle you overcome
adds another weapon to your arsenal.
comment_fortune_max:
I truly am fortunate, aren't I?
Your support is appreciated.

name: Awoken Batiste
description: Adopted into a noble family who later arranged for him to become a knight. He was selected for the Zero Guard during the previous emperor's reign. His disgust with the unsavory ruling class grew over time, in part because he knew he himself was not much different. That is why he respects straightforward people like Noel and Rayas who he silently uses to lift his spirit. He keeps his collection of knives in top shape by visiting local blacksmiths between missions.
comment_gain:
I'm glad I joined up with you.
I can trust you to watch my back.
comment_powerup:
Training isn't to keep your skills sharp,
but to make them sharper, even slightly.
comment_evolution:
I too have passion,
but it burns silently deep inside.
comment_limitberak:
Each obstacle you overcome
adds another weapon to your arsenal.
comment_fortune_max:
I truly am fortunate, aren't I?
Your support is appreciated.

description: Juno was born and raised in a remote village with her younger sister, but tragedy struck when the powers of her demonic blood awoke. Feared from that day as a descendant of the Crimson Blood Maiden, she was reluctantly exiled from the village. However, her awakening gave her a mysterious healing power, so she traveled the battlefields, treating the wounded. Her acts of compassion paved the road to the birth and rule of a new nation.
comment_gain:
You made it! Welcome to Granadia!
May your time here be filled with joy!
comment_powerup:
For a queen, this should be...nothing!
...Who am I kidding, I need a break!
comment_limitberak:
What's going on? You look... shocked?
Oh no... I didn't overdo it again, did I?
comment_fortune_max:
Chalk up another win for me!
No one's gonna stop my lucky streak!

name: Awoken Juno

My power has given me

name: Hart

Thanks for calling me.
I hope can I be of some help to you.

Effort will always be rewarded.

name: Awoken Hart

comment_gain:
It looks like my first impression was right.
You really are a nice guy.

It seems like I get my best ideas

No matter how scared you are,

I never expected I'd become this strong.

I'm lucky to have met everyone.
I hope we can be together forever...

name: Hart-Xi

I've been waiting for you to call me.
Everything's finally in place.
comment_powerup:
No need to be surprised.
That was the expected outcome.
comment_limitberak: The worst part is it can always get worse.
comment_fortune_max:
Meeting everyone was the luckiest thing
to happen to me, but that's ancient history.

name: Awoken Hart-Xi

comment_gain:
Let's go. There's nothing to fear.
Our cause is just.
comment_powerup:
Just a little more and I will
be able to realize my goals.

it takes to crush the empire.
comment_limitberak: The worst part is it can always get worse.
comment_fortune_max:
Meeting everyone was the luckiest thing
to happen to me, but that's ancient history.

name: Miranda

However, the broad smile that she gives her students shows nothing but fulfillment.

You've done well to come this far.

comment_powerup:
Don't rush progress.
Even little steps can take you far.
comment_limitberak: Hehehe, I can still fight on the front lines.
comment_fortune_max: Luck? That must be another one of his gifts.

name: Awoken Miranda

There's no need for words.

Together we'll protect what's important.
comment_powerup: You're never too old to make an effort!
comment_evolution: His words give me strength even now.
comment_limitberak: Hehehe, I can still fight on the front lines.
comment_fortune_max: Luck? That must be another one of his gifts.

name: Simon

Limits? Do you have time to think

name: Awoken Simon

Yet as he pointed his gun at her from the edge of town, his gaze was filled with dark intent.

How long will you drag your feet?
If you want my help, prove to me
how strong you and your determination is.

name: Vultee-Lr

I'm lucky to be alive.

name: Awoken Vultee-Lr
description: Carrying a turret in one hand, he has become an agent of pure destruction. His aggression runs counter to claims that he only harms his targets. Do you have the guts to keep going

comment_powerup:
I'm just one step away from
making my wish come true.
comment_evolution:
Breaking stuff is the only thing
this stupid power is good for,

comment_limitberak:
You might have limits, but me?
Not anymore.
comment_fortune_max:
I'm lucky to be alive.

name: Beach Majesty Juno
description: The queen of Granadia, a small country to the east, brought her sister to an ocean paradise. Her boasts of being the best swimmer in the kingdom was met with uncharacteristic protests from the captain of her Templars. To settle the dispute, they decided to race to the closest island and back, and loser would have to do anything the winner commanded. They stood at the starting line waiting for the signal, competitive spirit burning in their eyes.

Don't look so glum.

She claimed her lack of swimming talent was due to a curse that caused her to sink whenever she took a breath. Choosing instead to read beneath a parasol, the comfortable sea breeze started to convince her the trip was nonetheless enjoyable. All the while, a small group of green monsters was sneaking up on her.

Um, this is my first time going to the beach,

Humans were meant to exceed any limit.
comment_fortune_max:
On that day, I decided to give up happiness.
I'm not expecting it'll return to me.

name: Valentine Witch Liza
description: The first princess of Gran Verge outfitted by the Shiny Sphere for Valentine's Day. The same power that transformed her also provided the incredibly specific ability to turn Goldola ooze into a sweetener. Believing special occasions called for special methods, she decided to make chocolates with that. Cygnet's thorough taste (poison) testing paid off; her treats were indeed marvelous.
comment_gain:
Whoa, you surprised me!
Huh?! You want to see what I hid?
Don't look! It's still a secret!
comment_powerup:
I'm not just good at magic but alchemy as well!
The fates gave me two gifts!
comment_limitberak:
Magical alchemy...complete.
This breakthrough should lead to
new possibilities!
comment_fortune_max:
Ahhh! Is this a Panther Skullcap?
It's an endangered species of mushroom!
What luck to find one here!

name: Cute Confectioner Liza
description: She received a mint-green dress reminiscent of forest fairies after the Shiny Sphere observed her true essence. This also improved her alchemic talents with which she used to prepare the Valentine's chocolates. Regardless, she personally hoped for an ensemble with more mature charm.
comment_gain:
Ah, wait! It's almost ready!
Please hold on a little longer!
I'll give it today or it won't mean a thing.
comment_powerup:
Don't assume this is ordinary chocolate!
It's special-made with alchemy!
comment_evolution:
Ta-da! Here's your chocolate!
What, are you crying from happiness?
I'm getting a little embarrassed...
comment_limitberak:
Magical alchemy...complete.
This breakthrough should lead to
new possibilities!
comment_fortune_max:
Ahhh! Is this a Panther Skullcap?
It's an endangered species of mushroom!
What luck to find one here!

name: Valentine Soldier Cestina
description: An outfit made to gather ingredients for her cooking contest against her older sister. The cake knife-like sword cleanly cuts through any material, and her cream-filled macaron shield cushions any blow. It can also be eaten, suitable for long excursions. The only problem is that she tends to eat too much, causing tightness around her waistline.
comment_gain:
Just having them eat what I've made,
no matter how many times...ooooh...
Why do I still get nervous?!
comment_powerup:
Yep, better than ever!
It might even beat Liza's chocolate!
comment_limitberak:
This is getting better than store-bought!
It's important to always set new goals!
Simple admiration won't get you anywhere!
comment_fortune_max:
Hehehe, this turned out to be
a special day for us!

name: Pretty Patissière Cestina
description: To disprove her proud sister's claims, she is determined to make better sweets than her. Knowing that she lacked sheer talent, her approach was carefully selecting ingredients based on the preferences of the judges: her brothers. In imagining the smiling faces as they ate her perfectly crafted delicacies, the contest's purpose gradually shifted to simply enjoying time together.
comment_gain:
Not even the legendary confectioner,
Pure Grande, compares to this!
I can't wait to have the others try it!
comment_powerup:
I've barely even left the starting line.
The road to culinary mastery is long!
comment_evolution:
I'm so glad you liked it.
What, you thought I was confident?
I've been drenched in sweat the whole time!
comment_limitberak:
This is getting better than store-bought!
It's important to always set new goals!
Simple admiration won't get you anywhere!
comment_fortune_max:
Hehehe, this turned out to be
a special day for us!

name: Scarlet Enforcer Lark
description: The imperial intelligence bureau's greatest hit man. None of his targets have purportedly survived. However, he loathes surprise attacks and prefers direct confrontation. Fanatical devotion to the blade drives him to demand the most perilous missions, frightening his colleagues. The only one who does not keep him at arm's length is also the only one he accepts as competent: Jay.
comment_gain:
Abandon your sadness, hatred, and anger.
Once you surpass them all,
the essence of the blade comes into view.
comment_powerup:
The blade will never betray me,
and I will never betray the blade.
comment_limitberak:
Fighting spirit resides in the blade.
Resolve resides in the technique.
comment_fortune_max:
There is no such thing as fortune.
Everything was a result of my actions.

name: Scarlet Enforcer Lark
description: There were four historic styles of swordplay, each centered around fire, wind, water, or land. Only the scorching Entei-Ryu, ironically the most rigorous of them all, survived to the present day. He is its last practitioner, having attained mastery by killing his mentor with the school's ultimate technique. Thorough understanding of its moves and stances let him further modify them for maximum lethality. In another ironic twist, these changes were so dramatic the original style could hardly be recognized beneath them.
comment_gain:
Oh, you avoided my attack now?
Why would one of your skill want my help?
comment_powerup:
Whatever barrier you overcome
will become a new foundation.
comment_evolution:
Even drops of water will pierce stone.
My blade can cut anything at all
with sufficient training.
comment_limitberak:
Fighting spirit resides in the blade.
Resolve resides in the technique.
comment_fortune_max:
There is no such thing as fortune.
Everything was a result of my actions.

name: Elenore
description: One of the Six Witches of Grimm Stella. Known as the Witch of Peace, she gave the world many talented students. How she came to acquire such progressive ideas and knowledge was one of her greatest mysteries. Another was how she explained her neutral stance by saying, "I can't interfere with this era." Asking for confirmation about any aspect of her background produced the same result: "Would you rather focus on that or enjoy our time together?"
comment_gain:
Hi there! Welcome to Ms. Elenore's School of
World Peace! Why is the teacher in a swimsuit,
you ask? If you want to learn that secret...
comment_powerup:
Oh, nice score on this quiz.
Keep up the good work.
comment_limitberak:
Now, it's time to get some skin in the game!
...I didn't mean that literally, FYI.
comment_fortune_max:
This isn't a miracle, it's a result of your hard work.
Yep, Teacher guarantees that!

name: Elenore
description: Known as the Watcher in a different era. The reason she decided to interfere (even as a neutral party) in this one could either be regret from the outcome of that time or a whim from when she did not yet know the future (saying "when she was young" around her can be fatal). Grimm Stella might have learned something, and modern Lithomancers continue their research in order to fully understand her.
comment_gain:
I'm the headmaster of the School of World Peace,
but we'll leave formal introductions for later.
Let's cast off these doldrums and hit the beach!
comment_powerup:
Uh-huh, it looks like you're understanding
what world peace actually looks like.
comment_evolution:
I'm Elenore, just a plain old magic caster!
Does that answer your question?
comment_limitberak:
Now, it's time to get some skin in the game!
...I didn't mean that literally, FYI.
comment_fortune_max:
This isn't a miracle, it's a result of your hard work.
Yep, Teacher guarantees that!

name: Starblade Valerie
description: The newest member of the Adventurers' Guild Reigrad branch. Although she once trained alongside her best friend Charlotte under the hero Zeorg, the widening gap in ability convinced her to part ways with them. She sought to discover her weaknesses and strengths for the purpose of developing a fighting style all her own. The path was lonely, but she forged ahead, believing it would one day lead back to her old companion.
comment_gain:
This wasn't a coincidence.
This can't be called a miracle.
This is because I kept reaching out.
comment_powerup:
The EM Runner's becoming easier to use.
It was definitely meant for me!
comment_limitberak: I only have limits when I say so!
comment_fortune_max:
I can't brag about earning this power.
Sure, let's just say I'm lucky.

name: Cometstreak Valerie
description: A new adventurer who joined Rayas' journey. Born magic-deprived, Serah and Marika developed the Sorcel Igniter MP2 support device that allowed her to use spells for the first time. Whenever it feeds her with mana collected from the atmosphere, her hair turns bright red, also reflecting her heart ablaze with determination.
comment_gain:
You can place your hopes in me.
That's all I can do myself for now.
One day, I'll rise to the occasion.
comment_powerup:
I won't be picky.
I don't have the leisure of choice anyway.
comment_evolution:
If growing up means accepting
that there are some things you
can never do...then forget about it!
comment_limitberak: I only have limits when I say so!
comment_fortune_max:
I can't brag about earning this power.
Sure, let's just say I'm lucky.

name: Bloodrealm Guide Verzard
description: An enigmatic Demon who suddenly attacked Rayas' party. The blade of his scythe appears to be formed by a blood-like substance, but as it continually regenerates, it does not appear to be his blood if at all. However, its color causes those learned in Demon history to shudder at his mention of the Realm of Red.
comment_gain:
I shall redeem thy soul. Pray, be filled,
and sink. Anger, suffering, sadness
will be swallowed by the Realm of Red.
comment_powerup:
What do you find surprising?
This is but a facet of my power.
comment_limitberak:
Be aware that the Realm of Red is infinite.
It has neither limits nor bounds.
comment_fortune_max:
Behold this miracle.
I have received a vast power from beyond.

name: Verzard, Demise Pursuer
description: A Demon who fights with a scythe made of blood. He hunts Rayas to carry out his mission of reclaiming the Moonchild. His disdain for all non-Demons is such that he does not even care to remember their names, including that of the Divine Knights' commander. Thus, him addressing the red-haired Human who he fought in La Riiz is an exception among exceptions.
comment_gain:
Set aside your wariness. I won't take
your life so long as our covenant remains.
I only wish to maintain the dignity of my role.
comment_powerup:
Hm, though far from complete, it should be
more than enough to overwhelm them.
comment_evolution:
Look with awe, admiration, and
acceptance as death approaches.
None can resist it.
comment_limitberak:
Be aware that the Realm of Red is infinite.
It has neither limits nor bounds.
comment_fortune_max:
Behold this miracle.
I have received a vast power from beyond.

name: Buccaneer Captain Azel
description: An expert Demon bounty hunter who insists on calling himself a pirate. He sails from island to island, collecting treasure only to offload his findings without a second thought. This is apparently because his true lifetime goal is the discovery of the legendary Prism Regalia.
comment_gain:
All aboard! Treasure's waiting for us!
From today, you're a member of
my crew...of accomplices!
comment_powerup:
Whoa, looks like I got even better.
I'm so good it's scary.
comment_limitberak:
The view from here is better than I figured.
It's worth all the blood I had to spit up.
comment_fortune_max:
Luck decides the winner? Not exactly.
It's whoever catches it in their net.

name: Buccaneer Captain Azel
description: A self-styled Demon pirate seeking a legendary treasure called the Prism Regalia. Although his crew is diverse, there is no hostility among them as they all share an admiration for his straightforward gallantry. He occasionally holds parties where he will ramble about his grand vision of the future. However, no amount of grog can get him to reveal his past.
comment_gain:
You look like the type who won't
cave in to anything, even death. I like that!
Giving you a hand will be a nice warm-up!
comment_powerup:
That's nothing to lose your head about.
Doesn't take much to get stronger.
comment_evolution:
Good visibility, water smooth as glass!
Hold the rudder steady!
We're coming for ya, Prism Regalia!
comment_limitberak:
The view from here is better than I figured.
It's worth all the blood I had to spit up.
comment_fortune_max:
Luck decides the winner? Not exactly.
It's whoever catches it in their net.

name: [LB Unit] Weapon-Ear Chief Venna
description: A Beast with soft fur and adorable ears. She is actually the leader of a plucky but rare species known as the Weapon-Ears, though she presently travels with Azel. Unlike he who wears his pirate status with pride, she prefers to be called a treasure hunter. The iron ball attached to her leg carries a gripping tale full of drama which she will gladly share with friends after a few drinks.
comment_gain:
It looks like the jig's up. I'm not just the Fusion
Workshop's adorable operator. When I get into
combat mode, I'm a real sight to behold!
comment_powerup:
This is nowhere near what I'm capable of.
In fact, my potential is limitless.
comment_limitberak:
Hehehe, look at this splendid coat of beautiful fur!
I can picture crowds of yuppies begging to skin me!
comment_fortune_max:
LUCK is important! Everyone who has trained
to the limit learns that much, don'tcha know.

name: Weapon-Ear Chief Venna
description: The proud leader of the Weapon-Ears. Her entire colony was captured by hunters after their rare fur. They shackled an extremely heavy orb to her, but she was able to fight back and escape alone thanks to a number of errors on their part. First was underestimating her will to live and stave off extinction. Second was misjudging her incredible leg strength. Third was being unaware that orb was actually a Regalia of astounding offensive potential.
comment_gain:
Alrighty, it's time I got some skin in the game.
Hey, that's just a turn of phrase, silly.
comment_powerup:
What, is that seriously good enough for you?
I'm going to keep raising the bar, if that's alright.
comment_evolution:
The ultimate fusion of brains, bravery,
and beauty! That's me, haahahaaaa! ...Hm?
No, I wasn't waiting for you to make a wisecrack!

Hehehe, look at this splendid coat of beautiful fur!
I can picture crowds of yuppies begging to skin me!
comment_fortune_max:
LUCK is important! Everyone who has trained
to the limit learns that much, don'tcha know.

name: Katana God Luahn
description: The former second prince of Gran Verge. He abandoned his royal post to wander in search of his servant Chloe, who became separated after the worlds diverged. Due to the differing temporal flow, forty years for him was two millennia for her. The faint hope that her curse of immortality did not wane sustained him as he raced against the ruthless march of time.
comment_gain:
Allow me to boast of myself now,
of my unwillingness to accept fate.
Yes, there is no night without dawn.
comment_powerup:
I won't hold it back, I won't give myself over,
but I will join forces.
comment_limitberak:
Strength in perseverance, as they say.
I dislike mentioning it, but that method suits me.
comment_fortune_max:
I took a long detour to get here,
but it wasn't in vain. It let me make
several important connections.

name: Dragon Authority Luahn
description: When the Prima Rain fell two years after the Great Seal's destruction, his body became a vessel for the progenitor Dragon, Ama-no-Yuraragi. Presently, he governs the Dragons of the new world Altohelm. Continuing the search for the wayward Chloe with their aid, the pair was finally reunited in the sprawling forest near the Deus Gate.
comment_gain:
Come, let's be off.
We soar with Ama-no-Yuraragi,
venturing beyond the sky.
comment_powerup:
Power isn't enough. Wishes aren't enough.
Only together can they open our path.
comment_evolution:
The power to change reality is in my hand.
Perhaps the reason I continued to fight
was for this very day.
comment_limitberak:
Strength in perseverance, as they say.
I dislike mentioning it, but that method suits me.
comment_fortune_max:
I took a long detour to get here,
but it wasn't in vain. It let me make
several important connections.

name: Coastal Guardian Mira
description: The result of her believing the "one month to a sculpted figure" slogan of Celia's strict training regimen. A period of intense deskwork and calorie-based stress relief brought her weight to a dangerous level (by personal assessment), but she overcame that trial and stepped out onto the beach in the best shape of her life (by personal assessment). It even drew a slack-jawed reaction from one thickheaded adventurer in particular, prompting a mental fist pump.
comment_gain:
See, I wore a swimsuit this summer just for you.
Not that I expect much of a reaction from-- Hey!
Giving an honest compliment like that is unfair!
comment_powerup:
If I can stick to her training routine,
I'll reach my ideal proportions!
comment_limitberak:
Now's the time to unleash the animal inside!
That's right, today is Cheat Day!
comment_fortune_max:
Listen, I know that was purely an accident.
The lock on the changing room door was broken...
but you want to live, you'll forget what you saw.

name: Bay Royalty Mira
description: Made the most of her honed physique by wearing a light blue bikini and performing a series of complex calculations to determine her best angle. While training for the Water God Festival on the Beasts' island, she spent the most time practicing this pose out of the belief it would let her clinch victory. The sight of her sparkling under the summer sun was said to have stunned the entire crowd.
comment_gain:
Being a princess, I had to sneak out to come here!
You better be grateful that I let you join
my destressin-- *cough* I mean, vacation!
comment_powerup:
What?! Th-these are perfectly fine results!
You better not be comparing me to someone else!
comment_evolution:
Come on, don't sit down the first chance you get.
Summer has only just begun!
What should we do next?
comment_limitberak:
Now's the time to unleash the animal inside!
That's right, today is Cheat Day!
comment_fortune_max:
Listen, I know that was purely an accident.
The lock on the changing room door was broken...
but you want to live, you'll forget what you saw.

name: Sunblocking Beauty Celia
description: The disgraced princess of Bamint in a dark violet bikini. Among the many swimsuits she tried, it was the majority preference among her servants. Being (presumed) ruler of the world, such an opportunity was rare, so the idea of witnessing her glory on the beach drove them ecstatic. However, this was joined by disgust at sharing it with the unworthy, that brash adventurer she admired most of all.
comment_gain:
Why do you wear a shocked expression?
This outfit seems appropriate for a private beach.
Or perhaps...hehe, you can't turn your eyes away.
comment_powerup:
You should never turn your back on threats.
Here's the sunscreen. You can start with mine.
comment_limitberak:
Calm yourself! Down, down! Good gracious,
which of us is supposed to be breaking limits here?
comment_fortune_max:
It seems even I can misjudge the strength 
of the waves. ...Wipe that fortuitous look
off your face and help me recover my top!

name: Canopy Monarch Celia
description: The transcendent lady clad in the bikini most favored by her servants. Not only was this level of exposure noteworthy, the unimaginably stunning pose she struck while smiling was enough to enrapture any and all living things. Deeper than love at first sight, they were prepared to swear their immortal souls to her. Some servants still prefer her more proper side, however.
comment_gain:
Let's enjoy the opportunity to the fullest.
This is our very own paradise for two.
comment_powerup:
Adjusting this swimsuit was the correct choice.
Hehe, it seems I needed the room to grow.
comment_evolution:
Why are you so quick to avert your gaze?
Haha, you must want to render vain the effort
we put forth in choosing new swimsuits.
comment_limitberak:
Calm yourself! Down, down! Good gracious,
which of us is supposed to be breaking limits here?
comment_fortune_max:
It seems even I can misjudge the strength 
of the waves. ...Wipe that fortuitous look
off your face and help me recover my top!

name: Charlotte, Embers of Ambition
description: Enlisted in Famelle's knight order to fulfill her dream of becoming a hero. Any expectation of rocketing to the top of the ranks on sheer enthusiasm was quickly tempered as she sputtered like a wet fuse. The first princess of Famelle, unable to merely watch, appointed her to lead a groundbreaking new squad. However, this alternative offer was little encouragement since she felt her failures proved a lack of ability to command anyone.
comment_gain:
Sorry for the wait! Rabbit Squad Leader
Charlotte of Famelle's Elements
reporting in! Yeah!
comment_powerup:
Level up! Oh yeah, it always
feels good to get stronger!
comment_limitberak: I'll overcome as many limits as I have to!
comment_fortune_max:
OK, after lots and lots of saving up,
I finally filled out my stamp card!
What prize should I exchange it for?

name: Kindled Heroine Charlotte
description: Chosen to head Elements' newly formed Rabbit Squad. To demonstrate her potential, she attempted to control the Dark Blade Exceed Zechs. His inner world recreated her past, bringing back visions of the night she declared to her father she would become a hero. There was no longer any doubt in her mind; success was not a matter of "if" but "when".
comment_gain:
Let's go, Ceed!
It's time to show what we're made of!
comment_powerup:
One, two, three, four!
More, more! I'll grow stronger!
comment_evolution:
I won't let myself get discouraged again.
Whatever happens, I'll keep moving forward.
I've made up my mind to become a hero.
comment_limitberak: I'll overcome as many limits as I have to!
comment_fortune_max:
OK, after lots and lots of saving up,
I finally filled out my stamp card!
What prize should I exchange it for?

name: Misette
description: The original form of Iris, Rayas' travel companion. As one of Grimm Stella's Great Six Witches, she is known by "The Supreme Witch" or "The Farworld Witch". That world is believed to have a highly advanced civilization with giant iron mounts which soar at speeds exceeding sound and instant communication over long distances. Glimpses of her incomprehensible power may be derived from its technology.
comment_gain:
The gate has been opened.
Yes, our worlds are connected.
This is the dark side of the moon, as promised.
comment_powerup:
I do not see. I cannot feel.
Regardless, I...understand.
comment_limitberak:
Many strange events have occurred as of late.
Ever since meeting you, yes.
Also strange is how my heart leaps for that.
comment_fortune_max:
Luck alternates like two strands of a rope.
What is a miracle of salvation to one
may leave a lasting curse upon the land.

name: Misette
description: The past form of Reigrad adventurer Iris. She remembers her identity and actions, but the seal prevents her from recalling the outcomes. Any attempt to envision what happened at the base of the World Tree that fateful day causes her to lose consciousness. She bears interminable solitude, waiting for someone to reach out through the darkness.
comment_gain:
I am the Farworld Witch Misette.
So is written in Grimm Stella's book.
Thus, it is the role I play for the present.
comment_powerup:
I am not complete. I am not perfect.
However, I am more than enough.
comment_evolution:
Should I pray, the clouds part.
Should I wish, the stars fall.
Should I want, the world ends.
comment_limitberak:
Many strange events have occurred as of late.
Ever since meeting you, yes.
Also strange is how my heart leaps for that.
comment_fortune_max:
Luck alternates like two strands of a rope.
What is a miracle of salvation to one
may leave a lasting curse upon the land.

name: Devout Upholder Platina
description: The leader of the Divine Knights who oversees protection of Divine Guardian Uther. She appeared in Altohelm after the Prisma Rain fell. Although she castigated the previous captain's decision to defend a Demon girl, she later accepted it as another way of life. The one responsible for this mental growth was the shield-bearing Human who admired her... and the piano she played between training sessions.
comment_gain:
You who oppose and betray this world,
grasp your sword and fight beside me
until our destiny has been fulfilled.
comment_powerup:
My hands grow accustomed with each stroke.
I become integrated into the blade.
comment_limitberak:
As long as I hear that tone,
I will sink as deep as I must.
comment_fortune_max:
This is not the end, but a milestone?
Hehehe, I hope you'll continue to watch after me.

name: Godspeed Crusader Platina
description: Commander of the Divine Knights, also hailed as the Shining Knight. She laid low her enemies, Rayas included, with the sword Traumerei bestowed by Uther. The price of that power was losing a portion of her memories with each swing. However, she was able to retain her most important one: the melody she and her Human compatriot played immediately before the Great Seal's formation separated them.
comment_gain:
I harbor neither trepidation nor regret.
I wield this holy blade for the sake
of something greater than my life.
comment_powerup:
To become one with the sword
is the pinnacle of technique.
There is nothing to fear.
comment_evolution:
To fight against this warped flow of time,
to cut off this mistaken world...
O holy blade, give me strength.
comment_limitberak:
As long as I hear that tone,
I will sink as deep as I must.
comment_fortune_max:
This is not the end, but a milestone?
Hehehe, I hope you'll continue to watch after me.

name: Veteran Mercenary Natasha
description: Vice-captain of the Rabbit Squad. A weapon in her own right, she wields both a mace longer than her height and knives launched from her prosthetic right arm. Having previously fought in the God-Demon War as a mercenary with the Black Lions, she lost that arm fighting a blue-haired swordsman. Despite that constant reminder of conflict's hardship, a militaristic life was not without its upsides; the bonds formed with comrades gave her a heart.
comment_gain: Vice-captain of the Rabbit Squad, Natasha here. Nice to meet you. Hmm, that's a nice, solid body. What do you say about giving my training regimen a go?
comment_powerup:
Mm, I appreciate that.
The investment paid off.
comment_limitberak:
I'm only a weapon, but I've come this far.
No, with you all, I feel like I can go anywhere.
comment_fortune_max:
If I hadn't met Dad and the others back then,
I probably wouldn't be here now.
That was the most fortunate meeting.

name: Natasha: Spiritia 05
description:
Specimen designation: Spiritia 05
The fifth subject developed under the ----- Project. When connected to the spatial manipulator of the spacecraft Delphinus's Arceos construction unit, she gains identical functions. In this state, she can control space and matter within her field of vision, but there remains the issue of maintaining synchronization stability. Further testing and improvements will be needed before proceeding with mass production. -Y. Enova
comment_gain:
You look ready to move on.
Good, then I'll teach you the trick
to clearing a path.
comment_powerup:
I feel like you're giving me too much.
I'll gratefully make use of it.
comment_evolution:
Connection to Arceos, stable.
Integration score: 4.
I can tap into even more power!
comment_limitberak:
I'm only a weapon, but I've come this far.
No, with you all, I feel like I can go anywhere.
comment_fortune_max:
If I hadn't met Dad and the others back then,
I probably wouldn't be here now.
That was the most fortunate meeting.

name: Orvell D. Gran Verge
description: The first prince of old Gran Verge. He felt sheer necessity to reclaim Grand Destin from the Usurper; it was impossible to reign without the monarch's spirit inside. At the end of a lengthy journey, he finally defeated him and raised his reclaimed prize high. The cycle of setbacks and comebacks had given him a new soul and the confidence to call himself King Gran Verge.
comment_gain:
The old lynchpin ate at the world and
covered the sky in despair,
but don't worry -- Gran Verge has me.
comment_powerup:
Father's sword crosses with mine when
I close my eyes. I'm getting closer.
comment_limitberak:
I am not alone.
The four of us together can overcome anything.
comment_fortune_max:
It's nothing short of miraculous.
Liza is alive. The four of us are reunited.
I couldn't ask for anything more.

name: Kingsoul Orvell
description: The former first prince who assumed the title of King Gran Verge. The night after abandoning a girl in a burning forest to save more lives, he wept in grief over her lost future and her loved ones. He knew more difficult decisions awaited him, but he never wanted to forget or grow numb to the consequences. Through the agonizing, pondering, and suffering, he swore to always protect his people as their king.
comment_gain:
My name is Orvell.
I'm also King Gran Verge, but still Orvell.
comment_powerup:
This is a king's power. Even if a whole army
of Usurpers attack, I can fight them off.
comment_evolution:
Grand Destin and Gramlude.
With the Kingdom Blades of light and dark,
I become King Gran Verge.
comment_limitberak:
I am not alone.
The four of us together can overcome anything.
comment_fortune_max:
It's nothing short of miraculous.
Liza is alive. The four of us are reunited.
I couldn't ask for anything more.

name: Hotheaded Student Menas
description: A mysterious girl who woke up without her memories in the Royal Academy's rose garden. According to the equally mysterious support mecha Yuzukichi, her full name is Mena-Mena Menas. Though she was unable to recall even that much, King Jayn welcomed her as a transfer student. However, school life proved to be anything but peaceful since she was named by the student council president Princess Echika as her betrothed.
comment_gain:
M: "I'm Mena-Mena Menas,
a transfer student with no memories."
Y: "My name's Yuzukichi."
comment_powerup:
Y: "You were Enhanced!"
M: "Whoa, I'm filled with power!"
comment_limitberak:
Limit Breaking? Alright, I'll smash
those limits good!
comment_fortune_max:
Hehe, my Luck's turning around.
Maybe I can start relaxing a bit!

name: High-Soaring Menas
description: Despite suffering from amnesia, she is accustomed to scrapping. Already unbeatable in a one-on-one match, the metallic wings provided by Yuzukichi and the all-purpose weapon Multiple turn her into a force to be reckoned with. The belief burning deep in her heart ignites her spirit to soar across the blue skies, taking the students of the academy to destinations unknown.
comment_gain:
M: "I can't remember a thing. Tell me, who am I?"
Y: "You are a girl called Mena-Mena Menas."
comment_powerup:
I don't have any memories to go on,
but I know for sure I got stronger!
comment_evolution:
Y: "Ascension! Ascension!"
M: "Yeah, I just Ascended!"
comment_limitberak:
Limit Breaking? Alright, I'll smash
those limits good!
comment_fortune_max:
Hehe, my Luck's turning around.
Maybe I can start relaxing a bit!

name: Star Crest Rosetta
description: The young swordswoman of the Leone Templars. Although her princess and best friend departed from this world decades ago, she insists on that affiliation, believing she is not dead. The Crest Blade she holds, Seventh Artemis, is the key to rescuing Leone from confinement. She may be the last remaining Templar, but her duty is far from over.
comment_gain:
The genius is back!
Smart, strong, cute, and flawless Rosetta!
I'll be there before you can say my name!
comment_powerup:
Know your enemy, know yourself,
then formulate a solid plan.
All that's left is to win.
comment_limitberak:
The word "surrender" doesn't exist in
my dictionary! I deleted it a long time ago.
comment_fortune_max:
This is my true power, the outcome of genius
and effort! Don't assume it's all due to LUCK.

name: Rosetta, Forger of Fortitude
description: The Leone Templar who wields Star Crest Blade Seventh Artemis. She journeyed for decades with the purpose of saving her best friend from the Crimson World. Repeated clashes with Berwick, her senior in both the academy and the Templars, finally bore fruit in Falfania when they revealed their true feelings and came to an agreement to find the missing princess.
comment_gain:
Shine on, Seventh Artemis!
Let your light illuminate my path!
Guide me to Leone!
comment_powerup:
I'm not going to be stuck as a loser!
This time I'm really, really going all out!
comment_evolution:
I'll rescue Leone from the Crimson World.
I'll push back adversity, hardship,
impossibility, and logic, then reach out!
comment_limitberak:
The word "surrender" doesn't exist in
my dictionary! I deleted it a long time ago.
comment_fortune_max:
This is my true power, the outcome of genius
and effort! Don't assume it's all due to LUCK.

name: Assimilated Soldier Erens
description: A top-ranking officer in the archipelago company Lazuli. Unlike the majority of other executives with prestigious backgrounds, this orphan worked his way up purely relying on natural acumen. The inherent strength of his kind combined with expert-level swordplay make him unbeatable in combat, but he never lets pride interfere with his decision-making, ensuring victory whenever possible. Though he never speaks about his connection to Azel, emotions akin to rage and sadness emerge every time they clash.
comment_gain:
The strong eat the weak, and they are eaten
by the stronger. This law of nature is absolute,
but you broke the chain. Who...are you?
comment_powerup:
This armor restraining me howls.
The brute inside rages, demanding sacrifice!
comment_limitberak:
I will surpass them all: high barriers,
unformed roads, and the boundless sea.
comment_fortune_max:
I thought LUCK had abandoned me.
Since meeting you, something changed.

name: Assimilated Soldier Erens
description: Loyally fights for the Lazuli Company. A subject of their Super-Soldier experiments, he had one friend with a similar background. They were not friendly in the usual sense, since the other's freewheeling attitude often infuriated him. When that friend fled from the company, he deliberately disobeyed the order to capture and instead forced a plunge into the sea. None can tell what motivated that rare act of insubordination, least of all himself.
comment_gain:
The Dragon has been unleashed.
Now, give your orders.
What do you want of me?
comment_powerup:
Close your eyes and pray.
I am merciful in my painless executions.
comment_evolution:
Maybe the chains that tied me down
never existed from the beginning.
Yes, I should've wished for them to vanish.
comment_limitberak:
I will surpass them all: high barriers,
unformed roads, and the boundless sea.
comment_fortune_max:
I thought LUCK had abandoned me.
Since meeting you, something changed.

name: Selia, Sourcescript Witch
description: Traveled with the Lithomancer Yu-Long to undo the revisions in Grimm Stella's tales of the Six Witches while hiding that she was one of them. Moreover, she was the culprit who tampered with the other Witches' manuscripts. The reason for these incongruous actions would be revealed after unraveling the mystery of the Bantering Witch's story -- her own.
comment_gain:
The door has been opened because of you.
I will now speak of a true lie,
as genuine as I am.
comment_powerup:
Hehe, that isn't worth all the praise.
I just recovered some of my intuition.
comment_limitberak:
Write! Draw! Unleash your mind!
Selia's world has no boundaries!
comment_fortune_max:
Right now, I am happy. Hehehe, what's wrong?
You look like a pigeon who just got hit by
a peashooter. Sometimes I'll tell lies.

name: Selia, Sourcescript Witch
description: A Witch who journeyed with Lithomancers to undo revisions she placed herself. She saw potential in Yu-Long and refined his talent by guiding him to fix them. The falsehood in her story was her very existence in the real world, and she would vanish were it corrected. However, if that meant atoning for the disastrous Winter of Thaumazein, she was ready to accept the truth.
comment_gain:
Oh, don't get the wrong idea.
I have no intention of capitulating to you.
Why? Because we're business rivals.
comment_powerup:
Oh? I see, I see...
It appears I might actually be a genius.
comment_evolution:
Shall we be off?
We'll collect the remnants of Grimm Stella's dream
and witness what comes after the credits!
comment_limitberak:
Write! Draw! Unleash your mind!
Selia's world has no boundaries!
comment_fortune_max:
Right now, I am happy. Hehehe, what's wrong?
You look like a pigeon who just got hit by
a peashooter. Sometimes I'll tell lies.

name: Young Inheritor Isliid
description: The youthful form of Isliid's emperor who would go on to destroy the Great Seal and plunge Raktehelm into chaos. He obtained his late father's knowledge and will via the Succession of Isliid, which some call the last miracle of Humankind. That also included mastery in his preferred style of swordplay, the far eastern school of Sumera-ryu. However, the knight Roy refused to acknowledge his authority until he retrieved the missing Imperial Blades.
comment_gain:
The time has come.
Now, join the multitude of wills
and begin as Emperor Isliid.
comment_powerup:
The Sumera-ryu one-handed stance, Seamless.
Its possibilities are as endless as uncut cloth.
comment_limitberak:
I wish you wouldn't underestimate me.
The limits of Humankind are not so shallow.
comment_fortune_max:
I have become Emperor Isliid.
Not by obligation or destiny,
but by my own choice, my own will.

name: Last Miracle Isliid
description: The emperor of Isliid long before deciding to save Raktehelm at the cost of a third of the world's inhabitants. After obtaining Sky Light, one of the Imperial Blades, he could hear the voices of his predecessors. It foretold his individuality fading into their amassed consciousnesses. This brought him another step towards becoming the true emperor -- towards his ultimate choice regarding the fate of the Eight Great Races.
comment_gain:
The air has cleared.
The skies are as blue as on that day.
Were you waiting for me?
comment_powerup:
The Sumera-ryu secret technique, Raiko.
With its enactment, the battle is decided in a flash.
comment_evolution:
Pay heed to the might of Emperor Isliid.
I'll now spin this world's final myth.
comment_limitberak:
I wish you wouldn't underestimate me.
The limits of Humankind are not so shallow.
comment_fortune_max:
I have become Emperor Isliid.
Not by obligation or destiny,
but by my own choice, my own will.

name: Disciplinary Head Huma
description: Disciplinary leader and secretary of the Spirit institution King Jayn Royal Memorial Academy Higher Education Division's student council along with one of Princess Echika's Four Schoolmates. Befitting his role, he is serious and prizes order above all, yet the carefree Shaula and Morq tease him for his largely dry nature. He detests women as a whole with two exceptions: the princess, and Menas after losing to her in the rose garden.
comment_gain: My name is Huma. I am the Academy's student council secretary and head of the Disciplinary Committee. That means I am a keeper of law!
comment_powerup:
Power is filling my body.
Is this Princess Echika's guidance?
comment_limitberak:
I am surpassing limits...
the framework set by rules?
Is such a thing...permissible?!
comment_fortune_max:
To protect the order of this world,
I have been blessed by the deity of law!

name: Iron-Smashing Sword Huma
description: Second of Echika's Four Schoolmates, known as the Sword. The insistence upon rules comes from his lineage as a Spirit and Human. After the Humans' loss in the Spirit War, an accord prevented any further deaths. For the sake of its continued enforcement, he strives to establish a world where law and order are absolute. However, his bout against Menas caused him to question if there was perhaps a more noble cause.
comment_gain: To call me, secretary and disciplinary head, after school is commendable. I'll let you off easy with a Triple Punishment.
comment_powerup:
Dazzling, sublime, and precious.
This very light is indeed the light of order!
comment_evolution: My name is Huma. I am the Academy's student council secretary and head of the Disciplinary Committee.
comment_limitberak:
I am surpassing limits...
the framework set by rules?
Is such a thing...permissible?!
comment_fortune_max:
To protect the order of this world,
I have been blessed by the deity of law!

name: 星芯爆砕ゼファー
description: 後日公開予定

name: 星芯爆砕ゼファー
description: 後日公開予定

name: 閃光の文化部長シャウラ
description: 精霊族の通う王立記念学園で、スクールカースト最上位、『エチカ姫四学友』の一人。四学友内での序列は三位である。女性でありながら美少女好きで、文化部の美少女部長たちを集めて寮にハーレムを作っている。戦いの際には、この各部長たちを駆使して諜報や計略を行う。得意技は『煽りダンス』。罠にハマった者の前に華麗にあらわれ、このダンスを披露する様はまさに勝ち確演出であった。最近までは。
comment_gain:
エチカちゃん四学友が一人、
エチカちゃんだいすき侍シャウラ参上！
義によって同担排除するよー！　イェイ♪
comment_powerup:
見よ！　ただでさえ強いシャウラちゃん様が、
さらにレベルアップいたしました～！
comment_evolution: いっくよーー！せーの、超・覚・醒！　――シャウラちゃんから超スーパーシャウラちゃん様にパゥワーア～ップ！
comment_limitberak:
げ～～ん～～か～～い～～…とっぱーーっ！！
エチカちゃんの為なら何でもやっちゃうよー！
comment_fortune_max:
このシャウラちゃんは、
いわば愛と美と幸運の女神…
ゆえに自らもLUCK MAXなのだ！

name: 体育会統一王者ハイランダー
description: エチカ姫『四学友』の一人、序列第一位、別名『棍棒』のハイランダー。精霊族と巨人族の間に生まれた彼は、『本気』の戦いの際に、その身に宿した巨人族の血を使い、己の肉体を『活性化』することができる。だが、彼のその『本気』になれることは滅多にない。力をもてあます彼は、深い孤独の中、己に並び立つ強者を――真なる戦士（オトコ）を求めていた。そして、ミーナスが来た。
comment_gain:
さて、死にたくないヤツは道をあけろ。
死んでも引けねぇヤツは――来な。
戦士と戦士、真剣勝負といこうぜ！！
comment_powerup:
フッ、力が…力が…オオォ……
みなぎってきたぜぇええええ！！
comment_evolution:
見ろ……これが、活性化…！
俺様の本気、正真正銘超絶本気ってヤツよ！！
comment_limitberak:
戦士に限界なんて無い。
ゆえに限界突破…！　カベも天井もブチ破るッ！
comment_fortune_max:
俺はツキには頼らねぇ。
とはいえ……ま、イイコトがあるのは悪かねぇな。

name: Hunting Medium Atra
description: A Beast girl who joined the Rabbit Squad. Accompanied by Bado, a wolf-form Starbeast, she is a natural-born hunter who brings down every target without fail. Her dexterity also extends to talent in crafting and cooking. A specialist in camping cuisine, she turns her prey into sumptuous feasts that instantly captivate her company.
comment_gain:
I'm hunter of the Rabbit Squad, Atra.
This big guy is my partner Bado.
...Huh? Hey, Bado! Where'd you go?
comment_powerup: Te-te-re! Atra has leveled up!
comment_limitberak: To surpass your limits, you first have to know them then set goals. That's what my master and boss said.
comment_fortune_max: The luck to discover prime game is important. With that said, I'm heading out. You can look forward to dinner tonight.

name: Fanged Deitychild Atra
description: A Beast girl who serves as a medium for one of the Stardeities, Nature Deity Delmare. Also descended from the primordial Beast, the Fanged Hunter, she inherited the key to connecting to that Stardeity's power. Bado is an avatar of Delmare created from her genetics, and he always travels beside her as protector and mouthpiece for Delmare. "You think Delmare is selfish for a Stardeity? A far cry better than Auge, I'd say."
comment_gain:
Oh, you've got good taste to call on Atra and Bado.
Look forward to our unbeatable teamwork!
comment_powerup: Atra, ultra level up!
comment_evolution: Oh, this means...you want to see more of our fancy combo moves. Then we'll show you something special!
comment_limitberak: To surpass your limits, you first have to know them then set goals. That's what my master and boss said.
comment_fortune_max: The luck to discover prime game is important. With that said, I'm heading out. You can look forward to dinner tonight.

name: 蝙影の帰宅部長モルク
description: ジエン王記念高等教育学園、帰宅部――別名『鬼多苦武』は、夢からはみ出た少年少女たちによる不良グループである。その十三代目総長がこのモルクだ。帰宅部の長たるモルクの役目は、彼ら彼女らを家に帰すこと。学園世界からスラグ町へ、スラグ町から学園世界へ、そしてある時は、そのどちらでもない世界へと。彼は今宵も迷える者たちを、明けの明星へと誘う。
comment_gain:
ざーーんねん！！　ボクでしたー♪
アハハ、がっかりした？？　…って、なんだよ。
嬉しそうな顔しちゃってさ。…変なヤツ。
comment_powerup:
アハハ、強くなったんじゃないよ。
もとから強かった。これまで手加減してたんだ。
comment_evolution:
超覚醒ねぇ……覚醒はよくないなぁ。
目覚めていいコトなんて世界には無いよ？
comment_limitberak:
こうなったら仕方ない……限界突破ぁ！！
本気の本気、出しちゃうよぉ！！
comment_fortune_max:
世界で一番不平等なもの、それが運。
……でも今日はボク、ツイてるよぉ！！

name: 精霊王ジエン
description: かつて神魔の大戦期に、精霊族と人族の間で争いが起こった。精霊戦争と呼ばれるこの戦いは最終的に人族の勝利であったと伝えられるが、その際、精霊族の王は自ら戦場で剣を振るい、多くの人族の兵を道連れに力尽きた。かくして王の遺骸は、バーミント辺境の地に埋められ、悠久の時を眠ることとなった。ミーナスの見た二つの夢の世界は、化石化した遺骸から生じるプリマエーテルによって作られたものである。
comment_gain:
さぁ、剣を取りたまえ。
夢のような時間を分かち合おう。
comment_powerup:
驚かされたよ。
私にまだ強化の余地があったとはな。
comment_evolution:
夢はまもなく現実となる。
私は目覚めぬまま、
まどろみの中で世界を改変しよう。
comment_limitberak:
いいだろう。
君のためならば、限界をも超えてみせよう。
comment_fortune_max:
私は運がいい。嬉しいよ。
言うなれば……まるで夢のようだ。

name: Gravedigger Simon
description: A young man who joined the Rangers in an outlying Isliid town while an agent of another organization. The billowing cloak and top hat give him a unique style which secretly represents his shadowy double life. Beneath the brim is an expression as cold as ice and static as stone. More than a few have been captivated by that sadistic charm.
comment_gain:
I'm Simon. I joined the town Rangers.
My mission is to protect. That's all.
comment_powerup:
Hatred has this much power? It's only
a seed, but I'm looking forward to
the bloodstained flower that will grow.
comment_limitberak:
I've finally reached this point.
I'll choke the life from them...here and now!
comment_fortune_max:
I see it. There's no mistaking it now.
I should've known you were...an E-Factor Holder!

name: Simon the Eradicator
description: An assassin who vowed to massacre all E-Factor Holders. He eschews love and avoids socialization, stoically working towards his objective. This also motivated enlistment into the Rangers, a means of hiding his true nature. He wears the outward face of an affable prodigy to distract others from his deep-rooted hate, but his inner face is likely one of misery, being a stranger to compassion and a slave to vengeance.
comment_gain:
Everyone has secrets, don't they?
I'm ordinary in that regard.
comment_powerup:
The seed will soon germinate to bring
everything to an end. Beyond time and
distance, I will now pull the trigger.
comment_evolution:
There's no undoing things, only moving forward.
If I don't turn back, this path is just.
comment_limitberak:
I've finally reached this point.
I'll choke the life from them...here and now!
comment_fortune_max:
I see it. There's no mistaking it now.
I should've known you were...an E-Factor Holder!

name: Summer Magic Lotte & Valerie
description: In the anime series "The Magical Primawitches - Twin Fairies", the main characters transform with the Emotion Igniter, invented by genius professor Liza, to do battle against Manstors from the invading Muma Kingdom. This time, they ended up wearing swimsuit versions of their usual outfits, much to their surprise.
comment_gain:
C: "We're magical girls Charlotte and Valerie, appearing in swimsuits!"
V: "Wait, our names are supposed to be Prima Flare and Prima Nova."

V: "Igniter power-up complete."
C: "We got stronger!"

C: "We have no limits!"

C: "Magical girls will give you Luck today!"

name: Paired Passions Lotte & Valerie
description: The setting of the anime sees average girl Charlotte meet a mysterious comet girl Valerie, who both carry on the Primawitch legacy. Their swimsuit-clad versions are limited in the main series to episode 16. The only other appearance was the later crossover movie, where their signature fusion sword was used to destroy a massive enemy, giving them nicknames like "Titankillers" and "Twin Swimsuit Juggernauts".
comment_gain:
C: "The magical girls are here! Wait, what are we wearing? They look like swimsuits!"
V: "It seems our longing for the seas affected our transformation."
comment_powerup:
V: "Magical girl system, level up."
C: "The strongest has gotten stronger!"
comment_evolution:
C: "When my emotion grows, I feel this power from deep inside."
V: "The flame of feeling burns hotter, making magical girls stronger."

C: "We have no limits!"
V: "Be careful not to burn out."
comment_fortune_max:
C: "Magical girls will give you Luck today!"
V: "Not just today, but every day."

name: Flame Spirit Ignis
description: A Spirit said to have existed during the Ancient War. Humans sealed her away because of how she thought of herself as a flame of cleansing, eliminating all those who did not bend to her will. When she finally broke through the seal, her anger and hatred towards the Humans who had humiliated her were unparalleled. Her fury changed her into a bright flame and now she burns away, instantly turning all those who carelessly approach her into ashes.

name: Bright Sphere Spirit Wilkes
description: A Spirit who is believed to have existed during the Ancient War. Since she considered herself a noble being and avoided completely contacts with all other races, those who stepped into her sanctuary were considered sacrilegious and expelled without mercy. She possessed highly pure and powerful magic, that sealed to a gem, to protect herself. They say that the adventurers who lost their lives searching for that excelling power were countless.

name: Demon Fox Ugetsu
description: A gigantic Demon Fox that reigned above the Demons in the Far East. This humongous abomination which dyed the city red with blood was sealed by the Divine Blade Bizan after being defeated by the Shinobi in mortal combat. However, the Demon Fox preyed on the darkness of a young girl's heart and used beguiling words to trick her into breaking the seal. The divine blade waits in silence even now for the world to fill with the hearts of the evil as people seek power for their own benefit.

name: Mokyuon
description:
樹の力を宿した魔法生物。外敵の少ない綺麗
な森を好んで生息する。非常に臆病な性格　
で、人の気配を感じるとすぐに草の影に隠れ
てしまう。また、その姿は草木と見分けが付
きづらいので、初めて緑奏の森にやってきた
冒険者は森に住むモキュオンの存在に気づか
ないこともあるという。そのため、冒険者ギ
ルドではモキュオンの姿を見つけることがで
きれば初級冒険者卒業であるとされている。

name: Rekyuon
description:
ラクトヘルム全域に生息する炎の力を宿した
魔法生物。その愛くるしい外見や言葉遣いに
反し行動は攻撃的である。何も知らぬ旅人が
愛でようと近付きレキュオンの攻撃範囲に入
ると突如、口を大きく開き噛み付いてくる。
被害報告は各地で聞くことができるが、そこ
まで問題視されていない。それはレキュオン
の力がそこまで強くないため、単体相手では
生死に関わることが無いからかもしれない。

name: Garm the Two-Headed Hound
description: A demonic beast born once every tens of thousands of years within an inferno of flames. It rules over the Crimson Volcano and is said to devour even adamantite while having a body that is impenetrable to any common blade. Since ancient times, the alluring mysteries surrounding it have led many adventurers to challenge it within the Crimson Volcano. Seeking treasures such as its two heads that are said to generate infinite magic and its body that can heal any scar, most are never heard from again, left only to perish in a blaze of flames.

name: ゴルネコBIG
description:
ゴルネコが大金持ちになった姿。しかしどこ
まで行ってもゴルネコはゴルネコ。グランが
大好きな猫型生物である。身に着けている豪
華な装飾品はただの貯金がわりで、集めたグ
ランで贅沢をするような事は決してないとい
う。グランを集めるのは生物的な習性だと思
われていたが、近年の研究によって何らかの
目的のためであるらしいことがわかった。し
かし、肝心の目的は未だ解明されていない。

name: Fallen Beast God Eed
description: 数万年に一度、獄炎の中に生まれ、岩鉱を喰らうと言われる双頭の魔獣。炎を支配して灼熱の火山に君臨し続け、古来より多くの謎と共に語られてきたこの魔獣は、並の刃では傷すらつかない強靭な外皮を纏い、双頭のそれぞれに意志を持つ。業炎の中で傷を消す外殻、無尽蔵の魔力を生む双頭など、魅力的な伝承に釣られてこの魔獣に挑んだ者の多くは、その火焔の前に帰らざる者になったという。

name: Fallen Beast God Ifrit
description: A manifestation of the very concept of flame. It assumed Human form to acquire their rationality as a means of containing its all-consuming power, but that proved too strong to be suppressed without physical restraints. The most anyone can discern from its seemingly mindless rampaging is that it represents the planet itself testing the Human race.

description: 遥か東方の地において魔物の頂点に君臨した巨大な妖狐。都を血で染めた大怪異は、死闘の末シノビたちによって倒され、神刀「尾斬」に封じられた。しかし、妖狐はある少女の心の闇に付け込み、言葉巧みに惑わせ、利用し封印を打ち破っている。人々が己が利の為に力を求め、悪しき心で世が満ちるときを神刀は今でも静かに待っている。

name: Mohldora Ω
description:
精霊族の霊樹が世界を呪い変化した姿。古の
大戦期、戦いを嫌い同族と共に森の奥へと避
難していたが、戦火はその森へも及び同族や
森の動物達をも燃やし尽くしてしまった。奇
跡的に生き残ったモルドーラは全ての生物を
憎み、その魂を喰らう怪樹へと姿を変える。
その体から放たれる猛毒の霧には自身の種子
も含まれており、奪った命を養分にして新た
な復讐の苗木を増やし続けている。

name: Subject Ω
description: A creature abandoned in La Riiz's Magic Research Lab. Though highly resistant to magic, it appears to be highly unstable, losing all reason and suddenly shrieking in pain at random intervals. All materials related to the creature appear to have been intentionally destroyed. The only thing clear from conversation records kept at the lab is that two young men named Marius and Albert participated in experiments related to the creature.

name: ベルギラス・絶
description:
伝説に名を残す古の魔獣。巨大な体からは想
像ができない程俊敏な動きで獲物を捕らえ、
その鋭いカギ爪で瞬く間に止めを刺す。獰猛
な性格でありながらも、自らが認めた者に対
しては従属するような一面も見られ、獣族の
古い文献には魔獣を従えた王の伝説が残って
いる。しかし、ベルギラスを屈服させること
は容易ではなく、並の冒険者であれば出会っ
た次の瞬間には命を絶たれてしまうだろう。

name: Freydal Ω
description:
異界にそびえる氷の神殿の守護獣とされる怪
鳥。巨大な翼で羽ばたくと吹雪が巻き起こり
並の冒険者では立っていることすらできなく
なるという。その美しい羽根は高値で取引き
されるため戦いを挑む者が後を絶たないが、
市場にほとんど出回らないことがその者たち
の末路を物語っていると言える。これまでに
何体かの亜種が発見されており、それぞれが
異なる元素の力を取り込んでいるようだ。

name: Elpneumas Ω
description: ラクトヘルムの豊穣を約束する存在として古来より崇められた伝説の竜族。その身を土壌として世界の片隅で静かに生命を育んでいると伝えられていた。かの緑命竜が姿を現したのは、大地が精を失いやせ細り、芽吹きを忘れた時であった。それは人々が自然への感謝を忘れ文明に溺れたためである。目を覚まさぬ人々を、文明ごと壊滅させた緑命竜は、その地で眠りにつき大地を再生させた。

name: デグルマグナ・絶
description:
古代よりラクトヘルムの伝承に残る伝説の神
焔竜。数百年に１度、天変地異と共にその姿
を現すと伝えられている。身体中に流れる血
液はマグマよりも高温で、吐き出すブレスは
氷山を一瞬で溶かす程の威力を持つという。
神焔竜により焼き尽くされた大地には、草木
など新たな生命が宿ることは二度となく、デ
グルマグナを「滅界の死竜」の二つ名で呼　
び、祟り神として恐れる地域も少なくない。

name: ウィルクス・絶
description:
大戦期に存在したとされる精霊族。自らを高貴な存在と考え、他の種族と交わることを極端に避けていたため、自身の領域に踏み込んだ者は「聖域を冒涜する者」として容赦なく排除した。純度の高い強力な魔力を持ち、その魔力を宝玉に封印することによって自らの姿を
保っている。あらゆる魔導を凌駕すると言われたその力を求め、聖域に赴き命を落とす冒険者はあとを絶たなかったという。を現すと伝えられている。身体中に流れる血
液はマグマよりも高温で、吐き出すブレスは
